text:
NOTE
**Still not ready — the squash pulled 123 unrelated files into the PR**

New: The author squashed the branch into one commit and updated the description. Missing: the diff is now +4994/-5409 across 123 files (docs, web, scripts, lockfiles), though the fix was about 2 files. The history looks mangled by the merge or rebase. The PR also has no local test run and no linked issue.

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and assign no one.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for squashing. The PR now shows changes to 123 unrelated files, probably from the rebase or merge with main. Could you rebase onto current `main` so only the scheduled-message fix and its test remain? The [reviewable PRs guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/reviewable-prs.html) and [commit discipline guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/commit-discipline.html) explain how.
```
